state: Static preparation only. Official C14 source/binary tuple and current capture originals are pending FVD delivery.

official_identity.rule: Preformat, lock-diagnostic source and diagnostic ELF identities are not official C14 capture identities. Use only the official frozen tuple and original paths delivered by FVD and the sole evidence owner.

unchanged_tool_contract.rule: Reconcile these declared unchanged tool identities with each actual C14 packet. Their stability provides no old candidate-image or execution credit.

resource_sequence.before_ui_capture: FVD completes official Core, ARM and Perf BUILD plus QUALIFY serially before new UI actual capture.
resource_sequence.formal_measurement: Requires a separate Root exclusive resource GO. Build or qualification results are not formal measurements.
resource_sequence.reviewer_environment: Local static reading and assigned original image viewing only. No App, tests, build, probe, validator, SQL, SSH, hash command, copy or image processing by the coordinator or visual workers.

qualification_partition.authoritative_ids: The new C14 review packet's exact manual IDs and current original paths.
qualification_partition.batch_pw: Three current PW typing, selected-00 and held-inverse-01 frames; at most four actual opens with the assigned related original reference.
qualification_partition.batch_sc_ordinary: Three current SC ordinary typing, cancel and hidden-More select-last frames; at most four actual opens with the assigned related original reference.
qualification_partition.batch_sc_selected_picker: Three current SC selected-700 identities and the final picker frame; at most six actual opens with two assigned related original references.
qualification_partition.namespace_rule: Case labels containing c12 or c13 are reused recipe identities only. Every actual locator, source/binary declaration, case/state/action/log and run identity must belong to candidate14. Shared pixels do not waive an actual current opening.

full_round_partition.authoritative_ids: Each new full capture-only manifest's exact required_review_case_ids and required reference/group scope.
full_round_partition.baseline_scope: Preserve all original 554 required recipes, the three selected-700 cases, the three ordinary shortcut cases, all references and all required supplemental groups. All actual case evidence must be new C14 evidence in each round.
full_round_partition.stream_gate: Dispatch only immutable owner-completed modules after all assigned original files and owner inventory arrive locally. Reconcile every module case, PNG and evidence declaration against the final capture-only manifest.
full_round_partition.context: Every visual batch uses a new fork_turns=none worker. Metadata queue managers open no images and never add manual credit.
full_round_partition.ownership: The coordinator maintains the sole unique current-case ownership map and canonical ledger. Lanes receive distinct prepared batches and keep available visual slots filled before repetitive administrative work.
full_round_partition.compact_reporting: Cite immutable inventory and freeze tuple once; retain each current case's exact PNG/case/state/metadata/action/log/reference SHA, actual opening and concrete observation. Do not duplicate shared arrays or use past verdicts as current coverage.

review_contracts: Read complete distinguishable real-name-derived tokens and intact glyphs. Complete compact-name text is not required. Selected-700 00, 01 and 02 and ordinary tokens must be actually readable from new originals.
Visible configured shortcut selection provides identity. The independent caption supplies feedback for a hidden More scope; no new caption row is required for each visible shortcut.
Preserve existing PW inverse and bounds, draft, keyboard, picker folio and other accepted contracts. Compare appearance separately from retained action/state/fixture/runtime evidence.

Retained current download logs may expose an operational error even when a frame is readable. Report explicit terminal failures with exact current evidence for Root adjudication; do not infer runtime success from mechanical or visual PASS, or promote an uninvestigated log note into a defect without its actual scope.
A truly unreadable required detail remains pending until an actual owner-generated provenance-bound original-scale crop is read. No local crop or unviewed derivative can close it.

gates.affected: Official tuple plus all new qualification originals must be bound and actually reviewed with zero new actionable and zero required reading pending before affected clearance.
gates.round_one: Complete capture, exact current manual/reference coverage, final immutable identity reconciliation and zero unresolved new actionable or required pending are necessary.
gates.round_two: Use the same official C14 source, binary, references, tools and plan with a new complete capture and fresh actual manual review after complete round-one clearance and resource GO.
gates.recording: Only Root/FVD record clean after manual and same-source external evidence gates. Partial qualifications, diagnostic fixes or static preparation receive no clean credit.
